note: [L] proves the exact identity in Return.splits_zero and Collection.Local.actual from settled and Ingredients.exact_eval, where the trial variable enters only through exp(v*|Site|). The differences: the identity is normalized by target(1), and the trial variable is the free beta/tau arguments.

snippet.text:
lemma splits_zero {x : ℝ} (h : x∈l) (hp : 0 < target Q x 1) : let R := B.kin.path N m; let c := (B.a.params m).clip
    let r := B.a.budget m; let d := branch X R c r (a x) (B.kin.alpha N m); let _v := UVNext.CouplingReset.scalar (target Q) x
    ∀ U, (trunk R c r (shelves X R r) d (predictor B N Q x + Averaging.delta (X.read (a x))) 0).eval U * Real.exp (∑' i, d.logarithm i U) = target Q x U / target Q x 1 := by
  intro R c r d v U
  rw [eq_div_iff hp.ne',mul_comm _ (target Q x 1),← Real.exp_log hp,show Real.log (target Q x 1) = v*Fintype.card (Site (B.a.S.side m p)) from
    (div_mul_cancel₀ _ (sites_pos _).ne').symm, ← (support_bill g hm hb hx _ h).exact_eval]
  obtain ⟨H,hv⟩ := settled g hm hb hx he h
  unfold Template.trial board at H; rw [← hv,B.bases] at H
  exact congr_fun H U

proof_context.conclusion: The exact normalized identity holds with Delta = Averaging.delta(X.read(a x)) fixed by the preliminary data, proved from settled and exact_eval without a reset estimate.

lemma actual (hn : 20 < n.val) (hF : Fees G p c σ C α H w δ γ) (β τ : ℝ) :
    (finish R c p (shelves X R p) (branch X R c p v α) (β+α+delta (X.read v)) (vac v τ)).eval = earlyValue X R c p v β τ α := by
  ext U; rw [branch,(h.renew g hx hc hw α hn hF).unshifted]; exact h.raw_evaluator g hx hc hw α hn β τ U

proof_context.conclusion: The evaluation of the finished representation with shift beta+alpha+delta equals earlyValue, for any trial beta, tau.
